headline: Clear Lake and Wasagaming Vehicle Entry Requirements
reservation: Daily or annual park passes are required for entry and must be displayed on the vehicle dashboard. Accommodation at the Wasagaming campground or the historic Danceland area often fills months in advance through the Parks Canada Reservation Service; check official portals for the most current booking windows.

days.title: Manitoba Escarpment and Bison Vistas

stops.name: Lake Audy Bison Paddock
stops.detail: Drive through the enclosure to observe a managed herd of plains bison in their natural prairie habitat.

stops.name: Mount Agassiz
stops.detail: Take in the views from the edge of the Manitoba Escarpment, where the highland forest meets the agricultural plains.

days.driving: Allow 1-2 hours for the loop to Lake Audy; road conditions vary by recent rainfall.
days.note: Stay inside your vehicle when viewing bison to ensure safety and herd health.

days.title: Clear Lake Heritage and Waterways
days.start: Suggested: 10 AM from the Visitor Centre

stops.name: Wasagaming Townsite
stops.detail: Explore the historic log buildings and manicured gardens that characterize this 1930s-era resort village.

stops.name: Ominitik Marsh
stops.detail: Walk the boardwalk to view diverse birdlife and aquatic plants in a sheltered wetland environment.

days.driving: Local townsite travel is easily managed by foot or bicycle; allow 15 minutes for drives to nearby trailheads.
days.note: Watercraft must undergo mandatory inspection for invasive species at the designated station.

days.title: Boreal Forest and Backcountry Trails
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from the North Gate

stops.name: Moon Lake
stops.detail: Hike the trail encircling this quiet lake to see the transition between deciduous and boreal forests.

stops.name: Baldy Mountain
stops.detail: Visit the highest point in Manitoba for a panoramic view of the surrounding wilderness and forest canopy.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes to 1 hour to reach the northern park sectors from Wasagaming.
days.note: Be bear aware in these denser forest areas; carry bear spray and make noise.

intel.title: Wasagaming Congestion
intel.text: Parking near the Main Pier and Visitor Centre fills rapidly during July and August weekends. Utilize secondary lots near the beach or walk from regional campgrounds.

intel.title: Townsite vs Backcountry
intel.text: Reliable cell service is generally limited to Wasagaming and Highway 10. Expect signal loss on the west end trails and near Lake Audy.

intel.title: Gateway Service
intel.text: Full service stations are available in Wasagaming and Onanole just south of the park. Plan for limited services when traveling north toward Dauphin.

intel.title: Seasonal Shifts
intel.text: Many services in the townsite operate seasonally from May through October. Check the official site for specific facility closure dates in the autumn.

intel.title: Highway 10 Connectivity
intel.text: This major provincial route bisects the park, providing reliable year-round access. Side roads like the Lake Audy road are gravel and may be closed in early spring due to mud.

plan.arrival: Pick up supplies in Brandon or Dauphin before entering the park; check into the Wasagaming Visitor Centre for trail conditions.
plan.vehicle: Passenger cars are suitable for all major roads; RVs should check length limits for the Lake Audy loop.
plan.goldenHour: The Wasagaming Pier offers clear sunset views over Clear Lake, particularly in late summer.
